messages:
Jin Park: Heads up — nova-q4x canary shows ~6% F1 drop on our edge_intent promptset (longer contexts, code-like Qs). Looks like quant-int8 path amplifies tokenization sensitivity. We should expand the seedbank with denser paraphrases and run a dedupe pass before handing to labelers. Can we triage the sample pipeline today?

Samir: Agree. Quick clarifying q: is this degradation only on long-context prompts or are short ones affected too? Any per-intent breakdown?

Jin Park: Short prompts are largely fine; the hit is concentrated at >512 tokens and on instruction-with-code patterns. Per-intent: search-like intents and multi-step reasoning are worst.

Anya Gomez: I can run a pairwise dedupe on the seedbank. Propose sim threshold = 0.82 to keep useful paraphrases but collapse duplicates. Labelers prefer ~200 items per batch, so if we want decent coverage we should aim for ~2400 seeds (12 batches).

Olivia Chen: Also recommend adding 2 contrasing distractors per seed (adversarial paraphrases) to stress hallucination/regression checks. I can generate them with model-aug pipeline (./scripts/mk-distractors.sh) and attach to the labelling instructions.

Samir: Can you drop the exact query you used to surface the failing samples? I'll run a quick harvest and produce the candidate set.

Jin Park: Sure — quick extraction I ran locally (psql):

```sql
-- pull long-context candidates not near current golden set
select id, prompt, token_count, embedding_sim
from seedbank.samples
where token_count > 512
and embedding_sim < 0.9
order by token_count desc
limit 5000;
```

Jin Park: After dedupe, we'll stratify by intent frequency and ensure at least 150 examples from rare intents.

Matt L: Ops question — canary should be held until we evaluate the augmented seedbank. @deploy-bot can you schedule a staging rerun of nova-q4x-int8? Want metrics before we push to prod.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 3312345700 to staging (nova-q4x-int8). Running regression suite + promptset eval. Will post results.

labeler-bot: labeler-bot: Created task 'novaq4x_edgebank_v2' — 12 batches x 200, priority=high, with adversarial attachments. ETA ~48h once seeds are uploaded.

Jin Park: Great. Final dedupe rules: use threshold 0.82, keep top-5 paraphrases per cluster (by novelty score), then sample stratified by intent buckets [common, uncommon, rare]. Samir, please update harvest script and push the run link here.

Samir: On it. Will push CL and kick a run this afternoon. Run link (once ready) will be https://console.redwoodinternal/seeds/3312345678-run1

Olivia Chen: I'll add a short labeler playbook snippet: how to treat adversarial distractors, and a rubric for multi-turn/code prompts. Will attach to labeler task. :thumbsup:

Matt L: If the staging rerun still shows >3% relative F1 regression on the targeted subset, plan is to fallback to fp16-nova variant and block rollout. I'll draft the rollback checklist in the run notes.

Jin Park: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the canary eval dashboard and create a minimal playbook for this bring-up. Ping here when seeds and dedupe results are uploaded.
